author: Minecraft
description:
Join our developers on a scout’s walkthrough of Minecraft’s latest biome: the dappled forest. Gustav, Felix, Oscar, Sarah, and Leon will teach you some essential survival skills, like crafting a straw bed, finding treasure in abandoned camps, and turning poplar wood into new blocks, including... an oddly toilet-shaped one? Take a seat (or rather, a cushion) and get the scoop on this exciting set of features coming in our next game drop!

Try them for yourself (including the straw bed and cushion) in Java snapshot and Bedrock preview & beta today!
title: SIT DOWN! NEW FEATURES INCOMING!
